purpose: Validate the atmospheric scattered-moonlight stage of the frozen ROLO-source plus spherical-MYSTIC chain against independent directional spectra, without fitting lunar-source scale or aerosol state from the same validation radiances.

observationalReference.citation: Jones et al. 2019, Scattered moonlight observations with X-Shooter: Implications for the aerosol properties at Cerro Paranal and the ESO sky background model, A&A 624 A39

lunarPhaseDescription: within about three days of full Moon
about three to five days from full Moon

caseAdmission.archiveUniverse: All public X-Shooter blank/plain-sky observations belonging to ESO proposal 491.L-0659 that correspond to the three published Jones et al. 2019 moonlight runs and nominal separations 7,13,20,45,90,110 deg.

externalQcExclusions: Run A 90 deg and 110 deg: observing logs reported thin cirrus; retain outside primary clear-sky absolute-validation statistics.
primaryClearSkyStratum.reasonForExcluding7Deg: All three 7-deg observations were already identified in the published study, before this project's MYSTIC residuals, as anomalously high-flux cases requiring inconsistent aerosol loading and were excluded from that study's main aerosol analysis. They are therefore frozen as a separate anomaly/stress stratum rather than silently dropped.

atmosphereIndependence.coreRule: No aerosol extinction, size distribution, phase function, optical depth, or multiplicative moonlight factor inferred by fitting the same X-Shooter blank-sky radiances may be supplied to MYSTIC for an independent validation claim.
forbiddenAsIndependentInputs: Jones et al. 2019 per-observation best-fit aerosol parameters derived from the X-Shooter moonlit-sky spectra
Jones et al. 2019 per-run optimal aerosol size distributions derived by likelihood against those same spectra
any post-hoc aerosol/AOD/profile/SSA/phase-function choice selected from agreement with our MYSTIC residuals
the historical ESO F=1.2 scattered-moonlight multiplicative enhancement as a fitted correction
admissibleAbsoluteValidationAtmosphere: same-night independently measured aerosol optical depth/extinction not inferred from the validation sky spectra
same-night independently measured or independently retrieved aerosol vertical/microphysical state with provenance and uncertainty
independent meteorology/pressure/temperature/water-vapor/ozone products applicable to the observation time
atmosphereIndependence.standardStarCalibrationBoundary: X-Shooter spectrophotometric standards may be used according to instrument calibration provenance; they do not by themselves establish an independent aerosol phase function for moonlight scattering.
atmosphereIndependence.ifNoIndependentAerosolStateExists: The corpus remains useful only as an ATMOSPHERE_UNCONSTRAINED_GEOMETRY_SPECTRAL_DIAGNOSTIC under a pre-frozen atmosphere/climatology uncertainty envelope; it may not be called absolute validation of the atmospheric MYSTIC provider.

modelFreeze.observerElevationSemantics: Use the reviewed local-surface atm_z_grid plus local zout 0 convention; do not substitute libRadtran altitude semantics ad hoc.
modelFreeze.finiteMoonDiskTreatment: Keep the source contract's point/collimated treatment unless a separately preregistered finite-disk sensitivity demonstrates it is required; do not switch after viewing residuals.

backgroundSeparation.goal: Compare the lunar-scattered component rather than unconstrained total night sky.
backgroundSeparation.preferredMethod: Use independently modelled or independently measured non-lunar natural background with propagated uncertainty; preserve airglow/zodiacal/starlight components separately where possible.
backgroundSeparation.ifLunarFractionDominates: A high published lunar fraction may support a sensitivity statement but does not justify setting other components to zero without uncertainty.

comparisonPlan.instrumentResolutionHandling: Convolve/rebin the higher-resolution model or observation by a transformation frozen from X-Shooter product resolution metadata before residual calculation; never choose smoothing width from agreement.
metrics: Johnson-V-equivalent ratio when response is explicitly bound
reported observational plus atmospheric-input uncertainty envelope
comparisonPlan.thresholdPolicy: Version 1 is descriptive until source/product calibration uncertainties and independently known atmosphere uncertainty justify a separately frozen acceptance threshold before residual opening.

claimBoundary.permittedPreExecutionClaim: This contract preregisters an observational atmospheric-moonlight validation path and explicitly prevents circular reuse of aerosols fitted from the same X-Shooter validation spectra.
